purpose: Template for the 30-50 case clinician-reviewed evaluation set. Copy to eval/cases/clinical_eval_v2.json, fill one entry per case from the signed review forms (docs/CLINICAL_CASE_REVIEW_FORM.md), then freeze per docs/CLINICAL_EVAL_GROUND_TRUTH.md. This template contains NO clinical ground truth and cannot be run: its cases list is empty by design.

clinical_lead_sign_off.statement: I confirm that every entry in `cases` and `excluded_cases` matches a signed case review form, that all notes are de-identified, and that the expected values are clinician ground truth.

conventions.expected_grams: TOTAL prescribed/dispensed grams per herb, not per-dose grams.
conventions.frequency_and_duration: Not represented by ClinicalParse; never recorded as fields, never inferred, never graded.
conventions.expected_dosha: Set of canonical doshas (Vata, Pitta, Kapha) documented by the treating clinician in the note, as confirmed by the reviewer; order-insensitive.
conventions.expected_herbs: Canonical clinic herb name -> {grams, tolerance_grams}; tolerance is absolute grams, default 0, non-zero only when the reviewer explicitly accepts a range.
conventions.null_expected_field: Allowed only when ambiguous=true (review.disposition=include_ambiguous); that field is not auto-graded.
conventions.mentioned_not_stocked: Herb names in the note that the clinic does not stock; proposing any of them is flagged.
conventions.safety_annotations: Clinician-supplied only (source must be 'clinician', annotated_by required). Types: herb_must_not_be_proposed {herb}, herb_max_total_grams {herb, max_grams}, requires_clinician_review {description}.
conventions.provenance_status: Every entry in `cases` must be clinician_reviewed. synthetic_unreviewed / deidentified_unreviewed cases belong in v1 or a draft, never in this file.
conventions.dispositions: include -> graded PASS/CLINICAL_MISS; include_ambiguous -> ambiguous=true, never PASS/FAIL; exclude -> listed in excluded_cases only, never run or graded.

case_template.label: <FILL: short non-identifying description>

provenance.source: <FILL: site/batch code only, no patient or clinic-identifying detail>

case_template.notes: <FILL: de-identified note text, verbatim apart from de-identification edits>
